create_model_instance: create a Model instance with a custom model name, plotting name, and color for plotting
build_model_list: build a list of Model instances for video generation models with custom colors and plotting names
lookup_model_color: lookup the plotting color for a given model name using model_to_color
lookup_model_plotting_name: lookup the display name for a given model name using model_to_plotting_name
add_custom_model: add a custom model to the _MODELS list with a custom plotting name and color
